requirements.requirement: Identify a poem P and a book B, where B is a poetry collection and P is a poem from B.
Establish that the title of P is exactly one word and is in a language other than English.
Establish that the last line of P contains exactly two words, and that those two words are identical to the title of B.
Identify the author A of B and establish that B is the fourth book of poetry by A.
Establish that B won an award W, that the award win occurred between 2010 and 2020 inclusive, and that W was from an independent literary press.
Establish that the nomination for award W came from another well-known author C, and that C was born in the mid-1900s and has a PhD in folklore.
Determine the name of P and the name of B.
